_comment: Raw inputs of the visualization asset pipeline. sha256 pins the exact bytes; `python -m ADCS.viz.assets fetch` refuses anything else. URLs and sizes verified 2026-10-22.

bmng_topo_bathy_200407.description: Blue Marble Next Generation, July 2004, with topography and bathymetry shading; 21600x10800 equirectangular RGB, 500 m
bmng_topo_bathy_200407.license: NASA Earth Observatory imagery: free to use, including commercially; credit required
bmng_topo_bathy_200407.attribution: NASA Earth Observatory, Blue Marble Next Generation (R. Stockli et al.)

black_marble_2016_3km_gray.description: Black Marble 2016 night lights (VIIRS DNB, Suomi NPP), grayscale; 13500x6750 equirectangular, 3 km
black_marble_2016_3km_gray.license: NASA Earth Observatory imagery: free to use, including commercially; credit required
black_marble_2016_3km_gray.attribution: NASA Earth Observatory, Black Marble 2016 (NASA/NOAA Suomi NPP VIIRS)

clouds_bm2002_8192.description: Blue Marble 2002 global cloud composite (MODIS), cloud-only; 8192x4096 equirectangular
clouds_bm2002_8192.license: NASA Earth Observatory imagery: free to use, including commercially; credit required
clouds_bm2002_8192.attribution: NASA Earth Observatory, Blue Marble 2002 clouds (R. Stockli, R. Simmon; MODIS)

gebco08_elev_21600.description: Land elevation for Blue Marble, from GEBCO_08; 21600x10800 8-bit, ~25 m per step (0-6400 m, saturating), ocean and sea-level land = 0
gebco08_elev_21600.license: NASA Earth Observatory imagery derived from GEBCO (public domain); credit required
gebco08_elev_21600.attribution: NASA Earth Observatory, derived from the GEBCO_08 grid (GEBCO)

gebco08_bath_21600.description: Ocean depth for Blue Marble, from GEBCO_08; 21600x10800 paletted, land = 255, ocean = 0-254 (inland lakes are land)
gebco08_bath_21600.license: NASA Earth Observatory imagery derived from GEBCO (public domain); credit required
gebco08_bath_21600.attribution: NASA Earth Observatory, derived from the GEBCO_08 grid (GEBCO)

bsc5_cds.description: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised edition (9110 entries, V <= 6.5), J2000 positions, Vmag, B-V, proper motion
bsc5_cds.license: No explicit license; factual catalog treated as public domain; credit the authors and CDS
bsc5_cds.attribution: Hoffleit & Warren (1991), The Bright Star Catalogue, 5th Revised Ed. (Yale University Observatory); CDS VizieR catalogue V/50

svs_moon_color_4k.description: CGI Moon Kit colour map (LROC WAC, LOLA-filled poles); 4096x2048 equirectangular, longitude 0 at the centre
svs_moon_color_4k.license: NASA SVS: free to use; credit required
svs_moon_color_4k.attribution: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, CGI Moon Kit (LRO LROC WAC / LOLA)

svs_moon_ldem_4.description: CGI Moon Kit displacement (LOLA), 4 px/deg, float km relative to 1737.4 km; 1440x720 equirectangular
svs_moon_ldem_4.license: NASA SVS: free to use; credit required
svs_moon_ldem_4.attribution: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, CGI Moon Kit (LRO LOLA)
